28689: "The Treacherous", the most unpredictable Deity in existence. None know her true motives, nor why her Believers worship her. As her priestess, Kenith Abyssshade is as capricious as her deity. Even as one of Seven Blades' rulers, she never wielded her authority. In truth, she never considered herself part of Seven Blades, nor cared for her entire race. Her actions throughout her long HP follow no logic or purpose, sometimes even opposing her own Deity. Kenith is a walking enigma - appearing behind countless events, standing beside numerous Heroes, advising at faction roundtables. Life is but a game to her; joys and sorrows mere fleeting scenes. Yet calling her a Blade Storm would be unfair. Jaded by eternity, she finds little interest in anything... except those rare sparks that ignite her eyes, which become priceless treasures. #r Like "The Treacherous", Kenith remains shrouded in lies and prejudice - shields she deliberately maintains. She drifts through the world unbound by rules or opinions, like some mad prophet. Deep down, she seeks an anomaly: a possibility unwritten in history - the world's ultimate awakening. Once she pinned hopes on her Demonspawn kin, rebelling against ancient masters during the Obsidian Days, wishing suffering children would find their path. When darkness fell, she witnessed Mankinds' greatness, ultimately leaving Seven Blades to seek alternatives beyond eternal conflict. Make no mistake: neither Kenith nor her Deity are benevolent saviors. They merely uncovered secrets buried beneath ancient wars... and wish to keep their playground intact. Such emotionally intense yet self-absorbed beings are little different from a Blade Storm to others. #r Heeding prophecies and instincts, Kenith left the Circle of Calamity to wander the wider world. Ominous signs grew stronger, guiding her toward desolate Burningland to find what could make this stagnant world "interesting". Whether this is another trick by her scheming Deity matters not to Kenith. Any trap beats endless tedium in her long HP.
28690: Fort of Justice presents itself as the executor of law. To Caucaidian, the Believer of The Rebuke embodies righteousness—an impartial judge acting for the Archduke, an enforcer drawing clear lines between love and hatred, representing justice and order. Yet within those silver-and-iron halls, trusted members would open dust-covered codices to grasp the distinction between "law" and "justice". #rOriana came from a merchant family in Steelland. Though wealthy, their powerlessness meant their riches were like roadside berries for anyone to pluck. The Saling tragedy mirrored countless others: nobles seized assets under false partnerships, brazenly driving the defiant patriarch to death before casting his penniless widow and child into slums. Such events were Steelland commonplace—like cattle grazing grass—but that day, a Judicator from Libraland lodged in their town. #rOriana forever remembers that sunlit morning. The viscount who crushed her father and seized their fortune was marched to the scaffold by silver-armored knights, his once-arrogant face drained of color. As the executioner's axe fell, warm droplets sprayed before her. Oriana never wavered her gaze from the silver-scale emblem—that metallic gleam pierced her soul, proving the powerless needn't weep helplessly, and wrongdoers face reckoning. #rGrateful to these "silver figures", Madam Saling defied pressure to support Oriana's journey from Steelland to study imperial law in Libraland. Driven by passion, Oriana graduated with honors from Silver Shield Academy, served as a judicator in Libraland, and rose to renowned Judicator status among hundreds of peers. #rOver years of verdicts, Oriana became justice incarnate countless times, delivering both innocent joy and guilty tears through law she devoutly followed. Yet as experience grew and status climbed, scales in her heart gathered dust. Law granted power to punish evil—true—but verdict after verdict revealed its inherent bias. Seizing a destitute farmer's last copper coin, sending someone to Pit Mine over a single harsh word, openly favoring the powerful—was this her proclaimed "righteousness"? Oriana's faith crumbled; The Rebuke's sanctity faded. Seeking answers, she returned to Fort of Justice, unlocking the chained Primordial Codex in its sacred hall to glimpse The Rebuke's essence. #rOriana forever remembers that iron-gray night. Closing the Primordial Codex, she watched the hall's silver hues dim. The Grand Inquisitor's parched voice echoed: "Child, justice never existed. Law binds some by rules others approve—one's justice is another's tragedy. We follow others' rules, heed majorities blind to truth. That is 'justice'." #rLaw holds bias; statutes serve power. With bias, where lies impartiality? True justice is illusion; Judicators merely uphold order. Even the noblest can only patch fairness within their sight, helpless against order's crushing wheel. The Rebuke never deceived his Believers—most need no truth. If hoping for justice breeds obedience, so be it. The worst order beats chaos. To Deity or monarchs, order is foundation; all else just fills gaps in their reign. #rWhen faith shattered, Oriana became a true Judicator—God of Law's genuine Believers often scorn faith itself. From that day, her scepter fell not for Deity, but her creed: exposing injustice done in justice's name, awaiting a new codex—one starting with "righteousness". She exists not to judge sin, but to Protect innocence. Her scepter gathers dust, her Shield bears scars, yet her codex remains spotless. If law's machinery must crush innocents, let it begin with her.
28691: Baron Cohen has concluded from years of historical research that Caucaid historians are systematically forgetting and rewriting history. As an honest mage, he cannot allow true history to be frivolously dressed up. #r Among many titles like noble mage, renowned historian, and honorary knight, Cohen favors knight, which maintains dignity without pretentiousness. #r Studying history, or rather witnessing and reflecting on it, is both his job and passion. To delve into ancient history, he risks entering various ancient ruins to uncover the truths he seeks. #r His words are like a cold wind from the mountains, inadvertently chilling those who listen.
28692: Bai Qiuyu was once the leader of the Zhangwu League. Representing the Zhao-Yang martial arts community, he filed a complaint against Li Motong for corruption but was instead framed by Li Motong and executed at the Meridian Gate. To sever ties with Bai Qiuyu, the Bai family expelled Bai Qiuyu's wife and He Siren. He Siren, who had relied on her mother since childhood, wandered around Zhao-Yang. #r Following this, Li Motong's followers began a purge and pursuit. Fortunately, many of Bai Qiuyu's old friends were willing to take risks to shelter his wife and daughter. #r The case of Bai Qiuyu was complex and implicated many, becoming a topic everyone in Zhao-Yang knew but dared not discuss. She believed her father was framed and worked hard to clear his name by practicing martial arts. After years of effort, she was elected by the martial arts community as the new leader of the Zhangwu League, leading Zhao-Yang's martial arts in a new direction.
28693: Ascenders from Chen-Yuan, with mysterious origins and unknown backgrounds, were appointed as guest ministers by Honglu Temple, responsible for liaising with envoys from various countries. Under the instructions of Honglu Temple, they urgently traveled to Wu-Wei to welcome the distant Caucaid delegation. As the foremost land of celestial knowledge, the Chen-Yuan Empire has always been a sacred place in the hearts of practitioners worldwide. Various groups of ascenders hide in the mountains, single-mindedly pursuing the cause and effect of the celestial way and their own limits. These ascender families and sects appear quite mysterious to secular forces and rarely interact with outsiders, except due to secret agreements established during the founding of some dynasties, providing exceptional talents to the Tian-Shi Sect to help the empire operate efficiently. Gu Qianshan is one such individual. According to the folk legends of Nan-Xi, the Gui-Gu Sect opens its gates every thirty years, taking in two young disciples to teach them the secrets of Yin and Yang and the principles of the world. As one of the most mysterious sects of the Tian-Shi Sect, the operational mechanism of the Gui-Gu Sect is unknown, but each generation of its successors possesses extraordinary talents and strategies, being both masters of secret arts and brilliant strategists. In the military tents of every emperor who unifies the world, there is always the presence of the Gui-Gu Sect. Five years ago, the Gui-Gu Sect reopened, and Gu Qianshan, as the only descendant of the Gui-Gu Sect to leave the mountain in twenty years, was appointed by the Tian-Shi Sect to Honglu Temple, using her strategic skills to shield the empire from overt and covert threats in the diplomatic arena. #r        The guest ministers of Honglu Temple aren't just clerks sitting in high towers; they must follow the imperial missions to the farthest corners of the world, securing various benefits for the dynasty, from agreements to contracts.  #r        While the Chen-Yuan Empire follows diplomatic etiquette, most places in the world don't recognize diplomatic immunity, leaving envoys to face direct confrontations from failed negotiations or become targets of assassination by conspiratorial forces. Over her four years as a guest minister, Gu Qianshan has traversed the entire known world, encountering various ethnic groups and facing danger dozens of times, yet she remains unscathed. Descendants of the Gui-Gu Sect, besides being eloquent and knowledgeable, possess a secretive art of fire symbols. Many fear power but lack respect for virtue, and Gu Qianshan always has a backup plan for any situation. #r        Gu Qianshan is beautiful, poised, and exudes a unique charm that naturally draws people in. She never hides this charm, using it to lower opponents' defenses and increase her own appeal. Admirers of Gu Qianshan are endless, but only a few catch her eye. She approaches everything with a playful attitude. For her, clever debates and schemes are just games. What truly interests her is turning a slip of the tongue into real benefits outside the diplomatic arena. In the crowd, Gu Qianshan is always proud and lonely. Ordinary people are just pawns without thoughts and souls in her eyes. Only those who qualify as players themselves receive her slight favor and equal regard. However, as a frontline guest minister, Gu Qianshan lacks affection for those strategists who sit in temples and drive others around. She is versatile yet distant, running alone, knowing people worldwide, but no one truly enters her life and gains her recognition. Perhaps there is someone, but like footprints in the snow, they pass by and then go far away. #r        Gu Qianshan seems to have no desires. She wants nothing, yet her ambitions are vast. She continuously searches for a possibility, a desire inherited from the bones and blood of the Gui-Gu Sect—to open the heavenly gate, to question the nine cauldrons. The fragmentation of the world is a disaster, but also a ladder leading to magnificent dreams and a brilliant future. And this disaster is the grandest stage for the descendants of the Gui-Gu Sect. The descendants of the Gui-Gu Sect can only assist those who are outstanding among people. The purification of the six directions and the unification of the four borders shall begin today.
28694: Garcia, "The Rising of Orost", last survivor of the legendary knight order "Oath of the High Wall" and revered elder of The Rising faith. As a devout Believer bound by a nameless oath, Garcia lived solely as a Normal Paladin, never holding office in religious or secular courts. As the faith's influence grew, its actions drifted from Lady of The Rising's original tenets. Garcia voiced subtle concerns but found himself increasingly marginalized. When tensions escalated between Chamber of Rising Sun and Chen-Yuan court, he was exiled to the borderlands of Burningland. There he rejoined the Chamber of Rising Sun he helped establish and joined Knights Meltiron under the bishop's arrangement. Gathering truly devout knights, he fought for genuine faith and righteousness. Yet some wished this living legend would meet his end#r Historical records bear no trace of Garcia's birth. Believed to be the firstborn of a minor Burningland noble, he displayed profound piety from childhood. Renouncing his hereditary title as an adult, he journeyed with early Burningland converts to worship at The Rising dome. There he swore the strictest nameless oath, devoting his all to Lady of The Rising as her mortal embodiment. His powerful build and tenacity earned him a place among The Rising Paladins, battling darkness wherever sunlight failed to reach#r The nameless oath left scant records of Garcia's deeds, yet his legendary prowess made him a spiritual icon for all imperial Believers and knights. During the Great Veiling (a prolonged demon-caused eclipse), he volunteered to defend Orost—last bastion before the Circle of Calamity. Thirteen noble knights from across the empire swore oaths upon Orost's walls to defend every inch of light behind them, vowing to stand or die with the fortress. Known as "Oath of the High Wall", they became symbols of hope against endless demon tides. Through two dark years, countless commoners fell upon crumbling battlements while knights and militiamen perished alike under demonic blades. When dawn finally broke, shattered Orost stood—but barely one in ten defenders survived#r In their final frenzy, Demonspawn breached Orost at dawn's edge. They ravaged every inch of the unassuming City, masking bitter defeat with slaughter. Noble knights fell from steeds, sacred souls tainted by mud, gleaming armor lost in dust. Imperial reinforcements arriving with first light saw only a Burning city and a tiny squad covering wounded retreat#r Spotting reinforcements on the cliffs, the battered squad showed no relief. Leaving wounded with approaching allies, they turned toward the death-rattled ruins under their leader's command—a withered branch plunging into boundless fire. Garcia—the knight in plain bucket helm—spurred his gaunt warhorse toward sworn foes and unfulfilled oaths, with sunlight his sole ally trailing hoofbeats#r Thousands witnessed the century's greatest miracle. Fierce The Rising scorched away three years of darkness as Garcia became the dividing blade between dawn and dusk—Lady of The Rising's own blade. Arrows and Magic Burned before him while charging sunlight seared fleeing Demonspawn. Blinding white radiance—ghosts of Orost—materialized into twelve spectral knights behind him. Those who never saw dawn became dawn itself#r Before collapsing from exhaustion, Garcia's wrathful The Rising turned thousands of Demonspawn to ash. The miracle spread empire-wide, finally revealing his name—The Rising of Orost, last of the High Wall Oath. Healed, Garcia became The Rising's pride, the Caucaid Empire's Hero, an immortal legend—yet he shunned glory. For Protection, the faith barred him from battlefields despite his insistence on remaining a Normal Paladin. Returning to Burningland, he spread Lady of The Rising's benevolence and co-founded the ascendant Chamber of Rising Sun. The sword "Scorching Breath" gifted by Archduke of Burningland never left its sheath again#r Epics fade and legends crumble. Two decades on, aged Garcia watched new Hero tales replace Orost in children's dreams. Disgusted by the faith's corruption, he demanded to serve as Paladin once more. This time, they agreed. "Better to assign that venerated old statue to the frontier," thought many, "where some clash might give him a tragic Hero's end—perfect to stir up another wave of fervor for the faith."
28695: Bei-Ting soldier and Li-Shan Army Colonel, this decade-long Veteran brings extensive combat and frontline command experience. Before Bloodtooth Pass battle, his unit was reassigned militarily to Hengshan Protectorate, where Protector Yu Dingyuan secretly discharged him for covert ops. #r The Nan-Xi Peis are a powerhouse southwestern clan producing scholar-officials. As main lineage's second son, Pei Xingzhong rebelled against his Family's plans. Bright but restless, he failed College classics. By adulthood, this Outstanding talent lagged behind clan elites, but martial arts from guards and street Rangers thrived. After flopping Guang-Lu Temple exams, his father pulled strings to land him a Bei-Ting campaign clerk post – a five-year ticket to capital's Imperial Guards. Completing frontier duty would restore Pei Xingzhong as silk-robed nobility. #r New to the frontier, Pei Xingzhong sneered at rough-looking grunts. As a rare literate officer, he got desk duty under comrades' Protection, safe from Demonspawn steel. But youthful fire overrode safety. Sick of paperwork, he volunteered for cavalry raids into Circle of Calamity. #r When relief Commander came years later, the scarred Pei Xingzhong refused recall. Five frontier years shattered the dandy into a smoke-choked Veteran. Forged by comrades' blood and enemy blades, his patriotism made capital's luxury hollow. Rejecting the gilded transfer order, he got struck from clan records. Beneath Bei-Ting's scarred walls, Colonel Pei wiped tears and rode into darkness with steadfast brothers. Bei-Ting – home for the homeless – became his destiny. #r Five, seven, ten years... endless Demonspawn cycled comrades. Patrolling Circle of Calamity and Duan-Long Fort, he met travelers and even eastern Caucaidians crossing mountains to fight Demonspawn. Reassigned to Hengshan, he tasted bitterness at frontier tension like drawn Crossbows. His sword was for Demonspawn alone, never to drain HP from humans with Good in them. With his lieutenant, Pei Xingzhong surrendered insignia, scraped off markings, shed Heavy Armor, entered casualty rolls, then ghosted away to serve anew. Orders bind warriors, but this wasn't the Bei-Ting way.
28696: Colonel of the Loong-Town Guardian Troop, commands the marshal's personal guard and shares a long-standing rapport with garrison commander Bai Yuanshan. Known for straightforward Trait and formidable martial skills, she acts swiftly yet maintains an air of mystery, never removing her silver mask.#rSu Li's background remains shrouded in mystery—only known to have accompanied Bai Yuanshan since his appointment from Zhao-Lin. Some speculate she's a Martial Arts World master, others whisper she's an imperial Military Inspector spy. But Su Li defines herself solely as guardian of the Protectorate of Bei-Ting. Countless Demonspawn, cultivators of dark arts, and outlaws have fallen to her twin blades.#rSecrets abound in Loong City's ranks—rumors swirl about Li Shouyuan's health, Bai Yuanshan's past, and the face beneath Su Li's mask. Perhaps her true visage will validate some courtly or folk legend... Who knows? Haven't millennia of Bei-Ting snow concealed enough secrets?
28697: Mysterious Holy Elves bard who comes and goes like shadow, always appearing where tales unfold. Claims firsthand experience in epics, often speaking in cryptic riddles.#rEven among long-lived Holy Elves, Kris stands apart. She flaunts uniqueness yet guards secrets none uncover—not by design, but because even she may have forgotten the truth. Some mysteries... lie beyond mortal comprehension.
28698: Eldest son of House Hellason, heir to the Libra Archduke, and commander among Rebuke Knights. Calls himself the Silver Knight—valiant, decisive, charismatic, dreaming of extraordinary achievements and legendary fame.#rAs a knight, Neil embodies every tenet of the chivalric code and The Rebuke's laws. But as Libraland's heir, he has far to go. Lords must uphold honor yet know when to bend rules. Neil's driven by fervor, Family duty, and thirst for glory—enough to steel a knight's spine, but insufficient to bear a duchy's weight.#rThe Rebuke's servants don silver armor not for its sheen, but to deliver justice.
28699: The Iron Ember Congregation's Enforcer is responsible for investigating cases related to the Codex School. Known for their ruthless and aggressive methods, they have led the destruction of many underground churches and illegal gatherings. Codex Wizards retaliated fiercely, attacking Clem's home and abducting his sister, whose whereabouts remain unknown. #rOver the years, Clem has never stopped searching for her. Each time he dismantles a Codex School stronghold and witnesses the tragic fate of his colleagues' families, his hatred deepens. As an Judicator of Libraland, Clem should strictly adhere to the law, neither overstepping nor neglecting his duties. However, driven by hatred, his enforcement is extremely brutal, leaving almost no prisoners for questioning. Despite his achievements, Clem's conduct keeps him in the lower ranks, unable to advance. His combat skills are refined, but whether due to remorse or hatred, he always endures spells with his body, leaving visible scars. No one knows if he does this to punish himself or to increase his efficiency in killing Codex Wizards. To this day, Clem still fights on the front lines against them, even though his body is scarred and he cannot sleep without potions. No one knows when he will fall, but even if he becomes a ghost, Clem might sign a pact with the Silent to continue his hunt.
28700: A melody of elegance and grace rises, making the mountains and rivers seem weightless. #r In tavern tales and martial arts legends, the Palace of Startling Swans is ever-present. Many martial heroes dream of a cool, elegant heroine, her dress fluttering, arriving by moonlight to witness the world's splendor, leaving amidst blooming peach blossoms. #r The heroines of the Palace of Startling Swans are famous worldwide, but Luo Shanshan, a standout among the younger generation, remains unknown. Her style is quirky, she loves to sleep, is elusive, and has a charm that makes her endearing... The elders of the Palace find her troublesome. Yet, Luo Shanshan is exceptionally talented, mastering both skills and martial arts, and can innovate by combining body movements with energy techniques, leaving no room for criticism... The elders agreed she should be sent out of the Palace's comfort to let the harsh martial world refine her raw talent. #r During a training trip to the northern border of Chen-Yuan, her senior sisters left her in Wu-Wei County by simply not waking her. This straightforward genius from the Palace truly found herself bewildered upon waking, forced to experience the world's warmth and coldness outside the mountain gate. #r Naive, sincere, and a bit lucky, she has yet to see the cold side... Perhaps good luck is part of her skills.
28701: Xiao Beige is the top swordsman of Zhao-Yang, and the best in the world. He entered the Heavenly Prison with his sword just to speak with his friend Bai Qiuyu, who was about to be executed. One person, one sword, assassinated the treacherous minister Li Motong. #r What can a swordsman do in Zhao-Yang's current predicament? The limit of one person and one sword is just killing one, ten, a hundred... In the end, nothing changes. #r He's like a lone swan in autumn, flying towards an unreachable spring. The hunter in the shadows has already drawn the bow, aiming at him. Perhaps too much hope shouldn't be placed on a swordsman, perhaps he gave his all, yet ended up like this. That day, as leaves fell, he swore to avenge his friend Bai Qiuyu at his grave.
